 Portland Thorns vs. North Carolina Courage: Preview, Odds & How to Watch
 Charlie Zschau
 Published: 8 hours ago
 The North Carolina Courage travel West to take on the Portland Thorns in a crucial game in the push for the NWSL Playoffs. 
 Game 
 Portland Thorns vs. North Carolina Courage
 Date 
 Friday, October 23, 2026
 Time 
 10:00 PM ET / 7:00 PM PT
 Location 
 Providence Park, Portland, Oregon
 TV Channel 
 Prime Video
 With two games remaining in the NWSL season, the Portland Thorns and North Carolina Courage will face off in a tightly contested match, with playoff qualification on the line.
 The top eight teams in the NWSL qualify for the playoffs. The Portland Thorns are currently seventh with a 12-8-8 record and 44 points. The Courage are ninth with a 13-3-12 record and 42 points, but a win tonight would move them above the Thorns. The Seattle Reign are currently eighth and will face the sixth-ranked Utah Royals tonight.
 The Thorns have won just one of their last five matches, drawing three times. Their only defeat during that run came against Boston Legacy on October 3.
 The Courage have also recorded just one win in their last five matches, losing the other four. North Carolina’s most recent match was a 0-1 defeat to the San Diego Wave. Ashley Sanchez leads the NWSL with 20 goals this season, and her team will need her to help propel them into the playoffs.
 Thorns vs. Courage Start Time & Location
 The Portland Thorns host the North Carolina Courage at Providence Park in Portland, Oregon. 
The game will kickoff at 10:00 PM ET / 7:00 PM PT (Local) on Friday, October 23rd.
